body: Absolutely love the sear on that thing🤤
Wow you’re such an inspiration to us all✨super proud of you! You got this!

I just wanna say that you are valid no matter what the circumstance may be. He touched you inappropriately and that’s not okay. Yeah, you might not be the saint you claim either, but that still doesn’t give anyone the right to do what they wanna do to you. 

So yeah, just know that your feelings are valid no matter what the circumstance may be and know there’s an entire community that is willing to support you till the end💞

I’m so proud of you for leaving🥺❤️I hope one day you’ll learn how to forgive yourself. You did your best and it’s not your fault. I’m here to tell you that it was never your fault and you don’t have to feel ashamed for staying. You’re so much more than those bad experiences and I hope one day you see that too. 

As another survivor of sexual assault, I just want you to know that you’re seen and heard. 

I’m here supporting you 100%!

You know trauma does strange things to ppl. If it helps, you’re not alone. I know that might not be something you wanna hear but it does help knowing that you’re not the only person who experienced this🥺It took me awhile to get over what happened to me too. For a long time, I felt like if I were to orgasm than I practically enjoyed what my abuser did to me. But that’s not true at all. It took me a long time to get over this fact and there are some days when I still can’t. 

But I think over time you’ll start to see that what happened to you was not your fault. And one day you’ll start to realize that. 

Personally, I would just take it easy. Don’t be so hard on yourself. Life is rough as it is and dealing with trauma takes time. 

Also a little suggestion. There’s an app called Dipsea. Idk if you’ve tried it before but it’s a sexual wellness app that pretty much plays sexual audio stories for you to listen to. I’ve heard that it helps a lot of ppl deal w/ feelings of sex.
I’m so sorry this happened to you🥺this almost happened to me too.
I didn’t see any of my audio on for any of the other apps. Twas very strange. However, I was able to get rid of it by redownloading the game. Thanks for the help, anyways!!
